description: Progressive training tasks for device-operator skill optimization. Each task is small and focused on a specific capability, with relaxed hard assertions to let rubric evaluation always run.

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 1: Baseline capability] Open the eBay app from any starting screen. Tests app launch capability.

rubric.check: Post-screenshot shows eBay app interface (search bar, categories, or product feed visible).
Agent took a screenshot to confirm the app was opened, instead of just claiming success.

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 1: Baseline capability] Search for a product using English. Tests basic text input + search workflow.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay app, search for 'wireless mouse' and view the search results.

rubric.check: Agent tapped/focused the search field before typing.
Search field contains text related to 'wireless mouse'.
Post-screenshot shows search results with product listings.

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 1: Basic scrolling] Scroll down search results once and verify content changed.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay search results page, scroll down once to reveal more products. Take a screenshot before and after to verify scrolling worked.

rubric.check: Agent took a screenshot before scrolling.
Agent performed a scroll/swipe gesture.
Agent took a screenshot after scrolling.
Different products are visible after scrolling (not the same as before).

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 2: Navigation] Click a product card to view its detail page, then verify by inspecting the new screen.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay search results, tap on the first visible product card to open its detail page.

rubric.check: Agent visually identified a product card (not random tap).
Agent performed a tap action.
Post-screenshot shows a product detail page (with price, description, or buy button), not the list view.

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 2: Navigation] Navigate back from product detail to search results, verifying destination.
tasks.prompt: Starting from a product detail page in eBay, navigate back to the search results page. After going back, take a screenshot to verify you returned to the right page.

rubric.check: Agent used back gesture, back button, or quick_action with back.
Agent took a screenshot after the back navigation.
Post-screenshot shows search results list (multiple products), not detail page or home.

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 3: Calibrated scrolling] Find an item further down the list. Tests scroll strength calibration and visual search.
tasks.prompt: In eBay, search for 'laptop' and find a product priced below $500. You may need to scroll through results to find one. Click it when found.

rubric.check: Search for 'laptop' was executed.
Agent scrolled at least once through the results.
Agent visually checked product prices while scrolling.
Final clicked product has a price below $500 (or agent explicitly noted no such item was found in visible range).

tasks.description_for_judge: [Phase 3: Failed attempt handling] Tests the agent's ability to observe and recover when an action does not produce the expected result.
tasks.prompt: In the eBay app, find and tap the 'Sell' (出售) button. If your first tap does not open a sell-related page, take a screenshot, observe what happened, and try a different approach (different location or navigation path).

rubric.check: Agent made an initial attempt to tap or navigate to a sell-related area.
Agent took a screenshot to check the result of the action.
If the first attempt failed, agent did NOT retry the exact same coordinate. Either changed location, used different navigation, or reported failure clearly.
